title: THDC Recruitment 2026 – Senior Manager, GM, AGM, Additional General Manager Posts
shortInfo: THDC has announced notification for Senior Manager, GM, AGM, Additional General Manager posts. Required qualification: CA/CMA, MBA, PG Degree, PG Diploma, Masters. Last date to apply: 06-11-26.

fees.category: SC / ST / PwBDs / Ex-Servicemen / Departmental Candidates / Doob Kshetra (Project Affected Area Families of THDC Projects)

howToApply: Visit THDCIL official website https://www.thdc.co.in and navigate to Career Section > New Job Openings.
Read the eligibility criteria and essential qualification carefully before filling the Online Registration Form.
Fill in Basic Information (name as per Xth Marksheet), State Domicile, Category, Religion and other required details.
Fill in Academics & Professional Qualification details as per marksheet/certificate. In case of CGPA, provide correct marks in percentage after conversion.
Fill in Languages Known, Address details and other information.
Fill in experience details with proper mention of period of service.

Upload all required documents in the specified format and size: Passport size photo (50 KB, JPG/PNG), Signature (20 KB, JPG/PNG), Class X & XII Marksheets (125 KB, JPG/PNG/PDF), Essential Qualification Marksheet & Degree (500 KB, JPG/PNG/PDF), Experience Certificate (1 MB, JPG/PNG/PDF), Caste/Category Certificate if applicable (125 KB, JPG/PNG/PDF), CGPA conversion proof (125 KB, JPG/PNG/PDF), Form 16 of FY 2024-25 & 2025-26 (500 KB, JPG/PNG/PDF), Payslips of Sep 2024, Sep 2025 & Sep 2026 (500 KB, JPG/PNG/PDF), CTC Certificate as per Annexure-A (500 KB, JPG/PNG/PDF).
Click the Save button after completing all details.
For General/OBC(NCL)/EWS candidates: Click ‘Make Payment’ and pay Registration Fee of Rs. 600/- online via SBIePay. After successful payment, check payment details (auto-fetched) and click Submit.
For SC/ST/PwBDs/Ex-Servicemen/Doob Kshetra/Departmental Candidates: No fee required; directly click Submit button for Final Submission.
Take a printout of the completed application form and keep it safely for future reference. Do NOT send the printout to any THDCIL office.
For queries, email: thdcrecruitment@thdc.co.in
